d: Bihar Election 2025: Ramgarh, a stronghold of the RJD, is seeing a high-stakes electoral battle where the reputation of the former state party president and close aid of Lalu Yadav, Jagadanand Singh, is at risk. This time, Ajeet Kumar Singh, the younger son of Jagadanand, is running for the seat, which has been held by the RJD for the past eight terms. The 2020 Assembly election was an intensely close triangular contest, with the RJD’s Sudhakar Singh, elder son of Jagadanand Singh, winning by a mere 189 votes over the BSP’s Ambika Singh.
